root_cause: The header component unconditionally sets aria-hidden=true on the navigation menu when the menu button is collapsed (aria-expanded false), hiding the navigation links from assistive technology even on desktop where the menu is visually visible.
repair_strategy: Update the syncState method to conditionally apply aria-hidden only when the menu button is visible (mobile viewport) and the menu is not open; otherwise ensure the menu is exposed (aria-hidden=false).
expected_accessibility_effect: Navigation links will be exposed in the accessibility tree as links with correct accessible names, enabling screen reader and keyboard users to reach them.
functional_risks: Reliance on computed style may fail if the menu button's display property is changed dynamically in an unexpected way.
If the CSS for the header changes, the condition may need adjustment.
verification_requirements: Verify that at desktop width the navigation links have role link and names 'Apply', 'Renew a licence', 'Fishing rules'.
Verify that at mobile width the menu button toggles the navigation visibility and correctly sets aria-hidden and aria-expanded.
Ensure that opening and closing the menu via the button still works as expected.
Confirm no regression in the header's visual behavior across breakpoints.
